items.summary: Handoff: preserve the CRO and product-manager backlog as deferred, evidence-backed work only. Reject new change requests, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, and monetization changes until failure repair-or-close, validation, rollback, deduplication, isolation, and measurement gates are evidenced. Continue existing repair and read-only legal/security work.

Technical disposition: approve containment-only execution. Retain the three evidence-backed SEO and performance opportunities as deferred backlog; they are feasible and reversible in isolation but are not queue-eligible while failure repair-or-close, validation, rollback, deduplication, isolation, and measurement gates remain unresolved. Continue only existing repair, attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Do not create or requeue production work, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, monetization changes, or external outreach. Keep private launch gates unchanged.

Continue existing period-aligned measurement and attribution reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate provider commission as unattributed and retain unknown ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift. Do not treat impressions, clicks, rankings, sessions, conversions, performance scores, ordered items, or AI usage as financial returns.

Maintain the existing private launch gate and keep external outreach unsent. Continue only the consolidated read-only rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. Public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credentials, permissions, configuration, dependencies, and security-sensitive releases remain blocked pending required evidence, counsel review, and owner authorization.
